# myjfrog_servers (Data Source)

Provides a list of MyJFrog [servers](https://jfrog.com/help/r/jfrog-rest-apis/servers). This data source requires an API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "myjfrog_servers" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `servers` (Attributes List) List of servers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider.
- `region` (String) Region name.
- `server_name` (String) Server name.
- `server_type` (String) Server type.
